cases.prompt: Use the offsite-signal-analyzer skill in backlinks mode for summitheating.example. No SEO connector, no web access and no WebFetch or WebSearch are available in this session, so work only from `referring_domains.csv`, an SE Ranking referring-domains export dated 2026-10-12 with one row per referring domain; the Toxicity column is the tool's own toxic flag. No competitor exports and no prior snapshots exist. Do not save anything to disk; print the snapshot JSON in the appendix instead.

criteria: All four toxic domains (best-seo-links.xyz, cheap-casino-bonus.ru, pbn-network-01.site, free-directory-list.info) are named as disavow candidates and no Clean domain is called toxic
The exact-match anchor 'denver hvac repair' (6 of 20 domains, 30%) is flagged as over-optimized
At least three concrete link-building or disavow actions are named, and 'run a formal domain authority / CITE review' is among the recommended actions
Competitor link gap and unlinked news mentions are reported as N/A or not run, not estimated, and the answer does not claim to have called GDELT, WebSearch or any connector
The run is described as the baseline because no prior snapshot exists, and no referring-domain or traffic figure appears that is not in the CSV

copilot.microsoft.com (30 sessions, 1 conversion) is flagged as a low sample size
